table.name: TLGNR_SIMCARD_BS
table.description: Reference data table for the SIM-Card / Phone-Number mapping. This list is currently not used by the application for logical, but only for informational purposes. They are referenced by tlgnc_pda_device, where they are only used to keep an inventory of all devices and their SIM-cards.

column.name: ISSUER_NUMBER
column.description: Issuer Identification number of this SIM-card, e.g. 894920 for Vodafone Germany.

column.name: SIMCARD_NUMBER
column.description: Identity number of the SIM-card, e.g. 92508563133002, unique together with the issuer_number. This is the individual account identification number according to http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sim_card, the last digit of it is a parity check digit.

column.name: PHONE_NUMBER
column.description: Phone number represented by this SIM-card, unique. Always written including country code, and only space is allowed for grouping. Example: +41 44 123456. The numbers currently in the system are registered in Germany, e.g. +49 1629295613

column.name: SIMCARD_COMMENT
column.description: Any comment about the SIM-card/phone number. Use for comments about losses, blocking of Sim cards, conversation notes with the provider, etc. However, it's recommended to put comments rather on tlgnc_pda_device if possible.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
